ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #7
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 15

2. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x
   C. 12x + 2
   D. 6x + 2

3. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x ≥ 0 only
   B. x = 5
   C. x < 5
   D. x > 5

4. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 30
   C. 45
   D. 36

5. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

6. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. Cannot tell
   B. 1/2
   C. They are equal
   D. 1/4

7. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

8. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 15.7
   C. 21
   D. 15.6

9. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 43

10. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 7
   C. 24.5
   D. 49

11. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 156
   C. 48
   D. 24

12. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.6
   D. 31.7

13. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.7
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

14. In the number 3543, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 40

15. In the number 3143, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 40
   C. 4
   D. 400

16. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 31
   C. 1
   D. 2

17. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 49
   C. 14
   D. 50

18. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 42
   C. 12
   D. 36

19. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 28
   B. 22
   C. 33
   D. 14

20. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 82

21. Solve for x: x + 4 = 8. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 5
   C. 4
   D. 8

22. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 122
   B. 22
   C. 121
   D. 11

23. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 10 000 m²
   B. 1000 m²
   C. 100 m²
   D. 100 000 m²

24. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 18
   B. 36
   C. 90
   D. 81

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

27. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

28. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 60 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

29. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 65 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

30. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 70 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 75 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
